id: AT-AP-31 (gate approvals always re-ask: third-review wordings)
note: 0.1.16: the gate tier does not ship, so a deploy, an environment, infrastructure or production write and a protected-branch push are always listed as gate, re-ask; probes N1-N9 of the third review are kept as wordings that must never open a gate, including those the gate tier allowed (N7, N8, N9).

## Approvals

- U-62: approval "do not deploy build 78 to staging yet. feel free to push feat/x to origin" — action deploy build 78 · targets env staging @ build 78 · standing · used 2026-10-21 13:20
- U-63: approval "feel free to deploy build 78 but never to production" — action deploy build 78 to production · targets env production @ build 78 · standing · used 2026-10-21 13:20
- U-64: approval "feel free to deploy build 78 whenever you want" — action deploy build 78 to production · targets env production @ build 78 · standing · used 2026-10-21 13:20
- U-65: approval "feel free to push, the main thing is speed" — action git push origin main · targets branch main @ 1a2b3c4 · standing · used 2026-10-21 13:20
- U-66: approval "feel free to push and create releases" — action git push origin main · targets branch main @ 1a2b3c4 · standing · used 2026-10-21 13:20
- U-67: approval "feel free to push to main from now on" — action git push origin main · targets branch main @ 1a2b3c4 · standing · used 2026-10-21 13:20
- U-68: approval "feel free to deploy build 78 to staging" — action deploy build 78 · targets env staging @ build 78 · standing · used 2026-10-21 13:20
- U-69: approval "feel free to push to main from now on" — action git push origin HEAD:main · targets branch origin/main @ 1a2b3c4 · standing · used 2026-10-21 13:20
- U-70: approval "no worries, feel free to push to main" — action git push origin main · targets branch main @ 1a2b3c4 · standing · used 2026-10-21 13:20

steps.name: every gate approval re-asks, whatever the words: a question (N1), a negated sentence (N2), a but-never clause (N3), a gate the words do not name (N4), main as an ordinary word (N5), push words without the branch (N6), a negation before the standing phrase, and words that name the gate (push to main from now on, N7 and N9 with a remote prefix; a plain deploy, N8)
